items.title: Glamorous Summer Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you want to spend this hot summer at the beach? With this skin pack you can dress up this summer in the most amazing and fashionable way possible; from shorts and hats, to the best glasses and outfits, take the opportunity and be fashionable this summer.

- Twelve cool skins
- One skin totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Ninja Robots
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
What's more dangerous than a ninja? Robot ninjas! Grab this skin pack and do some cyber kung fu!

- 15 ninjas

items.title: Teens in Summer
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Who doesn't like to spend a summer at the beach? This is where we spend magical moments with our friends or family. Come and buy this fabulous skin pack that includes: 

- 5 male teen skins 
- 5 female teen skins 
- Plus 2 special summer teen skins
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Casual Mobs
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Your favorite mobs in their casual clothes. What does a creeper wear on their day off?

- Ten skins

items.title: 100 Days in MC, BUT...
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description:
100 GAME MODES IN ONE!
Random events every time you play
10 RARE custom Mobs / Entities

Can you survive 100 Days in Minecraft like your favorite YouTubers!? Experience “Minecraft but like” never before with a new unique challenge each day, like giant mobs, meteors, nether invasions, evil squids and more. Survive, farm and craft your way to take on the ender dragon!

items.title: FAIRY
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Become a fairy and make magical dreams come true! Join these cute fairies as they spread love and joy across the world!

+ Includes 10 fairy skins

items.title: SCP Breakout
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
The SCPs are breaking out to a browser near you! Check out SCP-040, SCP-682, SCP-099, SCP-049, SCP-079, SCP-173 and more!

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Ultimate Hacker Base
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Live in this ultimate hacker base and use special hacks to fly, scan for diamonds and much more!
Wear special hacker gear and hack into security cameras and laser systems!
items.changelog:
- Added Hacker Phone with 10 extra hacks
- Added custom hacker armor and tools
- Added hacker security camera system
- Added multiple ultimate hacker rooms to the base
- Updated world to 1.21.130
and more!

items.title: Redstone Mansion
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Are you tired of farming? Don’t want to open your doors manually anymore? Tired of taking the stairs? Want to leave your house with a TNT canon instead of the front door? This Redstone Mansion is perfect for you! With more than 30 redstone contraptions, all of your needs are taken care of!

+ Automatic doors
+ Security systems
+ Modern Mansion

items.title: Redstone
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Redstone fans rejoice! Another awesome skin pack made just for you! When you go mining in those caves use one of these skins while you dig up those beautiful glowing redstone ores!

items.title: Neon Mob Gamers
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These mobs are glowing gamers that look super cool as they game out all night! Which pro game loving mob will you choose? Perfect for night time neon glowing!

items.title: Blocky 4
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Check out these cool, colorful and fun blocky designs! Which pattern will you choose today?

items.title: Skaters
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Skate at the park and learn new tricks to impress your friends. 

+ 10 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Skaters

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Ores
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Pick your favourite ore! Hide from your friends and be a diamond, lapis or gold ore. Start your next mining trip and have a great adventure!

+ 8 different skins
+ Ores
+ Nether

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Powerful Demons
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Show your powers to the entire world and make a great place out of nothing! Be courageous, show your skills, and beat everyone like a true king. Give yourself a chance to shine in this crowded city and be a unique presence out here! Tune your life with colorful vibes and be the best version of yourself.

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mummy
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
For most burial is a final resting place especially when mummified, but these immortal beings have another idea. They have broken free from their tombs and are seeking vengeance on those who contributed to their death. You have nothing to fear, right?
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: TV Glitches
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Do you hate it when your tv glitches? Or perhaps when your monitor bugs out? Look no further! For now you can become the the glitch and rule the land! No? Well at least you can walk around with a big TV for a head!

- 5 skins

items.title: Ninja Life
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: The life of ninja is an adventurous yet ambitious journey. Full of obstacles to hurdle over and ninja moves to consistently train and level up! These ninja skins are perfect for roleplaying in your survival world or just using while you are leveling up and grinding that XP!

items.title: Parkour Robots
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Say goodbye to all those pesky scrap tins with these new, cutting-edge robotic models! These bots have even been outfitted with the latest, most fashionable designs in the industry. Get the parkour robot of your dreams now!

- 8 Robot Skins!
- Great for any parkour fan!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Zombie Takeover
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Zombies in movies have always been the scariest folks in town, but not anymore! This trendy gang is taking over undead fashion. Now you can eat brains in style with this teen zombified pack! Isn’t that the apocalypse dream?

- 8 Zombified Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Seasonal Styles
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Every season has a perfect outfit, and this pack has one for them all. Be flowerful and fresh for spring, bright and cheery for summer, snuggled up for fall, and cozy for winter. The choice is yours!

- 8 Seasonal Skins! 
- 2 for each season!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Sea Secret Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: A hidden bunker in the deepest parts of the ocean was found! The entrance is behind an oak tree at the sunny beach. Explore all its secrets and challenge yourself!

items.title: Trendy Team 2021
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Summer is here! Put on these trendy outfits and have a crazy summer with your team! Unleash your true personality with these trendy outfits, are you ready to have the life of your dreams?

Also perfect for PvP and PvE!

+ 18 Trendy Team 2021 Skins

items.title: Teen Style: Summer 2021
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Are looking to spruce up your Minecraft summer wardrobe? We’ve got just the thing you need…

11 HD (128px) skins including:

- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117
- 10 summer 2021 styles with a modern touch and bright colors.


Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.
